title: Innokin Plexus Replacement Pod 2ml
description: These genuine Innokin Plexus replacement pods are 2ml refillable cartridges designed for the Plexus Pro and Plexus Go tube-style kits. Each pod features a clean top-sliding refill and a 360° clear body so you can check e-liquid levels at a glance. With built-in mesh coils and three resistances to choose from, you can match your preferred draw and nicotine strength with ease. Choose your resistance: • 0.6ohm dual mesh: a looser MTL (mouth-to-lung) or light RDL (restricted direct-to-lung) vape; performs best on devices capable of around 20–25W (e.g. Plexus Pro). • 0.8ohm mesh: balanced MTL around 13–16W; included with both kits. • 1.2ohm mesh: a tighter, cooler MTL at roughly 10–13W. For best results, pair with 50/50 freebase or nicotine salt e-liquids. Replace the pod when flavour declines or the coil has reached the end of its life. Please Note: When filling your pod with e-liquid for the first time, allow the pod to sit for ten minutes before use. This will allow the e-liquid to better saturate the wicking material, a type of cotton, to prevent dry hits and ensure the best flavour and performance from your coil.
